name: Elk Island National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed; the park lists dog walking among its activities.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed; the park lists dog walking among its activities.

excerpts.quote: Keep dogs on a leash and under physical control at all times

dogRules.text: Dogs must be leashed and under control; off-leash dogs can provoke bison, moose, bears and coyotes.
Dogs can agitate bison and provoke attacks; keep them leashed near bison.
Store pet food and bowls securely at picnic areas.
